history.alt_text: A machined aluminum block cleanly split into two modules, with a heavy latch securing one half.
history.caption: The mechanics of IPO settlement automatically carve out a massive slice of equity for tax withholding.
history.title: IPO Tax Withholding Assembly

style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: Minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly on a weathered concrete surface, extreme asymmetric off-centre arrangement. Two recognizable engineered parts: a thick machined aluminum block cleanly split into two unequal modules, with a heavy anodized containment latch locking down nearly half of the structure. Hard clean edges, matte muted palette of industrial grey and brushed steel. One directional key light throwing a long, dramatic cast shadow across the concrete, generous empty negative space, deliberate architectural restraint.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, typography, watermarks, UI, numbers, people, face, hands, cubes, spheres
rationale: The story is about a strict structural rule and a single dividing number (47.7% withheld). A modular component assembly powerfully represents this unyielding, mechanical division of assets without resorting to literal finance clichés.
subject: a modular block cleanly divided by a heavy mechanical latch
core_thesis: At a liquidity event, the shares held back for tax and the assumed rate dictate what a worker actually keeps, rather than the headline valuation.
core_conflict: Headline paper valuation versus the harsh structural reality of massive tax withholding mechanisms.
alt_text: The 47.7 Percent IPO Tax. A machined aluminum block cleanly split into two modules, with a heavy latch securing one half.
caption: The 47.7 Percent IPO Tax: Why half your equity vanishes at a liquidity event.
title: The 47.7 Percent IPO Tax
